posts.title: German engineers assemble and drive a WW2-era Jeep in under 4 minutes
posts.description: We need a new family car, and this is closer to the kind that I want than all of the stuff on the market today. Too many extraneous chips, computers, and sensors, any one of which will cost you $$$$ when it inevitably fails.
